name: Unwip 0.44.98
body:
Everything since 0.44.91.

**Import / Export**
- The button in the bottom right of the main screen is now Import / Export. It asks "Moving a book?" and takes it one step at a time, whichever way the book is going.
- Bring a book in: your book first comes in exactly as it is, then you go through your manuscript, your characters, then the places and notes, and a last check shows every word came across. Split a long chapter at its headings or keep it whole, set deleted scenes aside, turn a cast list into one page per person or keep it as one document, and make pages for names that come up a lot. "Sort the rest later" keeps your place, and the button shows what's still to sort. You can turn the guide off in the room or in Settings.
- Send a book out: pick the book and where it's going (Scrivener, Word, Google Docs, Obsidian or a Markdown folder), then the shape it arrives in. For Scrivener that's as Unwip has it, as it came in (for books brought in from Scrivener), or chapters only. For Word it's one file, a file per chapter, or a file for Vellum or Atticus.
- Before anything is saved, "What changes on the way out" lists what travels in a different form, each with a tick box: character sheet gear as a list on each character's page, the Story Bible as one document, maps as pictures, comments in Scrivener's notes (or a Comments file), and in Obsidian the first mention of each character or place becomes a [[link]]. The last step counts the words in your manuscript and the words that went out, so you can see every one made it.
- Inside a book, Export › No hard feelings… opens the same steps with that book already picked. Export inside a book is still where you preview every page and make a print-ready PDF or an EPUB to publish, and each book's ⋯ menu on the main screen (iPhone too) now has Export…

**Fog of war**
- New at Focus: the Fog button beside Focus / Detail / Lore hides the book except the chapter you're on and the next one. It asks where you're starting: your "needs doing" list (right-click a chapter › Needs doing…), where you left off, or story order. "Done for now" moves you on and ticks the chapter off, Look up finds a character or place without lifting the fog, and the fog lifts when your list is done.

**Dropbox and devices**
- On an iPhone or iPad with a signal but no working connection, opening a book another device had changed showed "Couldn't check Dropbox", and Open anyway did nothing. It now opens within a few seconds, so you can keep writing offline.
- Conflicted copies (a chapter changed on two devices at once) now sit in their own section below the Trash, like Scrivener's, and each copy has a ⚠️ in your chapter list. Drag one out to wherever you want it and it becomes an ordinary document, or delete it.
- Deleting a book everywhere no longer waits for Dropbox to finish uploading it first. Deleting on this device only still sends its latest changes first, and tells you that's what it's waiting for.
- Importing with auto sync on: syncing waits until the whole book is in, then sends it in one go, so the count only goes down. The count shows only files that actually need sending or fetching.
- Recently updated no longer calls a change from another device "this computer". Each device has its own hidden ID, and phones and iPads say "this iPhone" or "this iPad".
